changes: Six Russian translations; English and Ukrainian menu entries omitted.
Case-insensitive URQL comparisons replace toLowerCase on answers, including Ё/ё.
Exact bounded integer percentage table replaces percentageRatio.
Cover image omitted; plain Russian translation menu.
Input is assigned as a value, preserving quotes and punctuation instead of interpolating executable URQL.
The malformed insert_var link for кот in ru_v5_5 is repaired.
TOKENS slots and an index replace JSON arrays and slicing.
URQL Fisher-Yates consumes the same RNG draws as the original JavaScript.
The initial five-way shuffle, appended return home and six-way reshuffles are preserved.
Nær og Fjern is transliterated to Naer og Fjern in the historical note.
All story locations and choices are preserved; no JavaScript executes.
Static JSON notes become optional URQL procedure buttons, retaining the current location, original actions and return links.
Browser markup, music and illustrations are omitted; they are not required for choices.
Latin accents and Japanese titles in translator notes are transliterated for M8; Russian Ё/Й are preserved.
Long narrative paragraphs are split into consecutive print statements without truncation.
A brief launch screen links to the complete original preface, author credits, license and acknowledgments under About.
